The structure of MgMn2(OF)2 crystallizes in the triclinic space group P1 (No. 119), with a unit cell containing 9 atoms across 9 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mg and Mn centers each coordinated by six neighbors, with Mg surrounded by 3 F and 3 O, while Mn environments involve mixed F/O neighbors. Oxygen and fluorine centers adopt 4- and 5-neighbor environments, respectively, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 9 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between 5-vertex F and 6-vertex O polyhedra, and corner-sharing between 4-vertex F and 6-vertex Mn polyhedra.
